title: [GMCP 203.046.01] Contract: Property testing, fuzzing, model checking, and continuous red-team
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-046-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: All parsers, serializers, state machines, URI/schema evaluators, policy decisions and transport boundaries have invariant/property tests and coverage-guided fuzz targets with retained regression seeds. Lifecycle, task and subscription models are checked for safety/liveness; threat-model abuse cases map to automated adversarial tests; sanitizer and red-team campaigns report zero unresolved critical/high findings at release. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
